name: old_deinocheirus_arms
description: OLD DRAWING plate (019): Deinocheirus as known for 50 years: just the two enormous arms (three big hooked claws each) drawn crossed in front, and a dark brown filled QUESTION MARK silhouette where the body should be. Brown-ink engraving style, parchment fills, cross-hatching, transparent background, no text. Sits on old_drawing_card at the same centre. Anchor centre, fits x -340..340, y -200..200.
